blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Robotic novel view synthesis (NVS) must recover both visual appearance and metric 3D structure, yet most generative NVS methods rely only on images, overlooking LiDAR, a complementary sensor common on robotic platforms. We present M3GD, a Camera–LiDAR multimodal representation for generative NVS that composes independently pretrained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation models without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator.
We show that, after camera projection, frozen LiDAR and image features exhibit substantial shared spatial structure, providing a natural cross-modal representation.
M3GD conditions generation on LiDAR through this structure: it combines explicit geometry statistics with learned point-cloud descriptors into view-aligned packets on the image-latent grid, injected through a lightweight residual adapter into a multi-view flow-matching generator whose latent space, decoders, and training objective remain intact.
On the GrandTour dataset, M3GD improves target-view RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version of the same backbone.
Ablations show that the gains come from pixel-aligned LiDAR content and that target-view LiDAR acts as a geometric query linking the requested view to source observations.
Deployment on a ground robot demonstrates practical real-world operation, with a configurable quality–cost trade-off controlled by the number of Euler integration steps.
blocks.zh:
机器人小说视图合成(NVS)必须同时恢复视觉外观和度量的3D结构,然而大多数基因的NVS方法只依靠图像,俯瞰机器人平台上常见的一种互补传感器LiDAR. 我们提出M3GD,一种用于基因NVS的相机-LiDAR多模式表示,它独立地编译预先训练的2D图像和3D点-云基模型,而不单独预先训练跨模式翻译器.
我们显示,在摄像头投影后,冷冻的LiDAR和图像特征呈现出大量共享的空间结构,提供了自然的跨模式表现.
M3GD通过这个结构在LiDAR上条件生成:它将清晰的几何统计与学习的点-云描述符结合成图像相对格上的视向包,通过轻量级的剩余适配器注入多视向流配对生成器,其潜伏空间,解码器和培训目标保持不变.
在GrandTour数据集上,M3GD改进了目标视图RGB和深度合成,比起同一主干部分的仅图像版本.
缩写显示收益来自像素对齐的LiDAR内容,而目标视图LiDAR则起到连接所请求的视图与源观测的几何查询的作用.
地面机器人的部署表明实际世界的运作,可配置的质量-成本权衡由欧拉整合步骤的数目控制。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Novel view synthesis (NVS), i.e., predicting the image a camera would capture from an unvisited viewpoint, turns recorded or mapped environments into reusable visual testbeds for robots. View-controllable rendering has been used to train or evaluate learning-based driving and drone policies in closed-loop simulation [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . The underlying radiance-field representations also support photorealistic mapping for localization and geometric reconstruction [ 4 ] , while synthesized viewpoints give teleoperators visual coverage beyond the physical camera layout of a robot [ 5 ] . Recent generative NVS systems have advanced rapidly by building on 2D image representations and multi-view diffusion models [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . However, computer vision benchmarks usually pose NVS as RGB-to-RGB synthesis from posed images alone. Conversely, robotic deployment changes the input boundary: cameras are commonly synchronized with calibrated LiDAR, metric structure is operationally important, and a LiDAR sweep near the queried pose may exist even when the target RGB image is unavailable. We treat such target-side LiDAR as a geometric query : it anchors the requested viewpoint and local metric support without revealing the target appearance to be synthesized. This matters especially where RGB-only synthesis is difficult: texture-poor corridors, thin structures, harsh illumination, and long-range outdoor geometry. The core question is therefore not whether another sensor can be added, but whether pretrained 2D and 3D representations can be composed so that visual appearance and metric structure help the same generative NVS model.
blocks.zh: 小说视图合成(NVS),即预测一个相机从未访问的视角可以捕捉到的图像,将录制或映射的环境变成机器人可重复使用的视觉试验床. 视图可控渲染被用于在闭路模拟中培训或评价基于学习的驾驶和无人机政策[1,2,3]. 基本的辐射场表示也支持光现实化绘图,用于局部化和几何重建[4],而综合观点则给予远程操作者超出机器人物理相机布局的视觉覆盖[5]. 最近的基因NVS系统通过基于2D图像表达和多视图传播模型[6,7,8]而迅速进步. 然而,计算机视觉基准通常将NVS作为单从所展示的图像合成的RGB到RGB. 反之,机器人部署会改变输入边界:相机通常与校准的LiDAR同步,度量结构在操作上很重要,即使目标RGB图像不可用,在被询问的姿势附近也可能存在LiDAR扫描. 我们把这种目标侧LiDAR当作一个几何查询:它锁定了请求的视角和当地的度量支持,而不透露要合成的目标外观. 这一点尤其重要,因为只有RGB的合成是困难的:纹理贫乏的走廊,薄的结构,严酷的照明,以及远程室外几何. 因此,核心问题不是是否可以添加另一个传感器,而是是否可以将预先训练的2D和3D表示物组成,从而使视觉外观和度量结构帮助同一个基因NVS模型.

blocks.en: Most existing NVS methods address only part of this problem. Generative approaches synthesize plausible target views from RGB observations and their associated camera poses [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] , while feed-forward radiance-field and splatting methods reconstruct renderable scene representations from sparse images [ 13 , 6 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . A separate line of work employs depth or LiDAR to supervise view synthesis, but typically requires fitting or updating an object- or environment-specific representation before novel views can be queried [ 17 , 18 , 2 , 19 ] . Together, these limitations motivate the RGB–LiDAR-conditioned generative NVS setting studied in this work. Given posed source RGB–LiDAR observations and a target query comprising a camera pose and synchronized LiDAR sweep, the goal is to predict the target-view RGB image and dense depth without fitting a scene-specific representation at deployment.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的NVS方法只解决了这个问题的一部分. 基因方法综合了来自RGB观测及其相关相机的可信目标观点[9、10、11、12],而向导辐射场和镀层方法则从稀薄的图像中重建了可渲染的场景表现[13、6、14、15、16]。 单独的一行工作使用深度或LiDAR来监督视图综合,但通常需要安装或更新针对对象或环境的表述,然后才能对新观点提出疑问[17、18、2、19]。 这些限制共同激励了本作品中研究的RGB-LiDAR有条件的基因NVS设定. 考虑到RGB-LiDAR的源头观测和由相机布置和同步的LiDAR扫描组成的目标查询,目标是预测目标视图RGB的图像和密集深度,而不在部署时安装特定场景的表示。

blocks.en: The challenge in combining these sensing modalities stems from their heterogeneity. Images are dense, appearance-rich, and indexed by pixels whereas LiDAR data is sparse, unordered, and indexed by metric 3D coordinates. Image evidence carries texture, geometry, illumination, and semantic context, whereas LiDAR carries scale-accurate support, range, and free-space structure. Their learned representations also differ in spatial support, dimensionality, pretraining objective, and invariances. Naively, collapsing LiDAR to a dense depth map discards much of its support structure, while forcing a generative model to learn a full cross-modal translator turns fusion into an additional synthesis problem.
blocks.zh: 结合这些感知方式的挑战来自其异质性。 图像稠密,外观丰富,以像素为索引,而LiDAR数据则稀少,无序,以公尺3D坐标为索引. 图像证据带有纹理,几何,照明,和语义上下文,而LiDAR则带有比例精确的支持,范围,和自由空间结构. 它们在空间支持、维度、培训前目标以及变化方面学到的表述也各不相同。 自然地,将LiDAR崩溃成密集的深度图会丢弃其大部分支持结构,同时迫使基因模型学习一个完整的跨模式翻译器将聚变变成一个额外的合成问题.

blocks.en: This paper studies RGB–LiDAR fusion as a representation-composition problem. Collecting synchronized, calibrated multimodal robot data across diverse environments limits the scale available for training each NVS system from scratch, making it attractive to reuse visual and geometric priors learned from broader pretraining data. Rather than training image–point alignment explicitly [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] or rebuilding the NVS model around a new sensor stack, we ask whether a pair of independently trained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation representations is compatible after camera projection. If a projected 3D representation is legible to the image-latent space of a given generator, then LiDAR can enter NVS as spatially aligned metric evidence instead of being reduced to an auxiliary loss, a per-scene reconstruction prior, or a single hand-crafted depth image.
blocks.zh: 本文研究了RGB–LiDAR聚变作为一个代表-组合问题. 跨不同环境收集同步,校准的多式联运机器人数据,从零开始限制每个NVS系统的训练可用规模,使其具有重新利用从更广泛的预训数据中吸取的视觉和几何前科的吸引力. 而不是在新传感器堆周围重建NVS模型, 而是在摄像头投影后一对独立训练的2D图像和3D点-云基表示是否兼容。 如果一个投影的3D表示可以清晰地看到给定的生成器的图像相对空间,那么LiDAR就可以作为空间对齐的度量证据输入NVS,而不是被降低为辅助损失,每层重建前,或者单个手工制作的深度图像.

blocks.en: We instantiate this perspective with M3GD, an RGB–LiDAR multimodal representation for generative NVS. We analyze a particular pairing of frozen Depth Anything 3 (DA3) image features and Utonia point-cloud features [ 23 , 24 ] and find that they share substantial spatial structure after camera projection. Each M3GD LiDAR packet then combines two complementary representations derived from the same sweep on the same image-latent grid: explicit geometry statistics retain direct information about metric range, sampling support, and sensor timing, while pooled Utonia descriptors expose learned 3D structure from point-cloud pretraining. Their concatenation provides a view-aligned representation between LiDAR and the generative NVS backbone. The resulting design keeps the paper’s focus: how to combine dense appearance reasoning with both explicit and learned sparse 3D evidence without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator.
blocks.zh: 我们用M3GD即基因无核素的RGB-LiDAR多式联运表示这一视角。 我们分析一个特定的对齐 冻结深度 Anything 3(DA3) 图像特征和 Utonia 点云特征 [23,24] ,发现它们在相机投影后具有实质性的空间结构. 每个M3GD LiDAR包随后结合了从同一图像相对网格上的同一扫描中得出的两个互补的表示:清晰的几何统计保留了关于度量范围,采样支持和传感器计时的直接信息,而集合的Utonia描述符则暴露了从点云预训中吸取的3D结构. 他们的凝聚在LiDAR和基因的NVS骨干之间提供了景色协调的代表. 由此产生的设计保持了论文的焦点:如何将密集的外观推理与所学的显性及稀少的立体证据结合起来,而不对跨模式翻译进行单独的预先训练.

blocks.en: Our contributions are therefore summarized as follows: • We identify a specific class of independently trained, frozen 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation representation pairs whose projected 3D features share substantial spatial structure with the 2D image latents. This cross-modal compatibility motivates their incorporation into an image-latent generative model. • We introduce M3GD, an RGB–LiDAR multimodal conditioning method for generative NVS that combines explicit geometry statistics with learned point-cloud foundation-model descriptors in a projected feature representation and injects it into an image-latent generative model trained with multimodal flow matching, without requiring separate pretraining of a cross-modal translator. • We evaluate M3GD on GrandTour and show that adding projected LiDAR packets improves RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version. • We deploy M3GD on a wheeled ground robot with a different camera–LiDAR sensor suite in a real-world environment without any retraining on the target domain. This demonstrates that the learned conditioning generalizes across platforms, and establishes its practical relevance for robotic perception tasks.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的贡献概述如下: 我们确定一组经过独立训练的,冷冻的2D图像和3D点-云基代表对,其预测的3D特征与2D图像潜伏物具有实质性的空间结构. 这种跨模式的兼容性促使它们融入图像相对基因模型。 我们引入了M3GD,一种用于基因NVS的RGB-LiDAR多式联运方法,将明确的几何统计与学识的点-云基模型描述符结合在一个预测特征表述中,并注入一个经过多模式流匹配培训的图像相对基因模型,而不需要对跨模式翻译进行单独的预训。 我们在GrandTour上评价M3GD,并显示,增加预测的LiDAR包可以改进RGB和深度合成,而不是只使用图像的版本。 我们在现实世界环境中,将M3GD部署在一个带有不同相机的轮式地面机器人上-LiDAR传感器套件上,而不对目标领域进行任何再培训。 这表明,所学的调理贯穿各个平台,并确立了其对机器人感知任务的实际相关性。

This cross-modal compatibility motivates their incorporation into an image-latent generative model.

blocks.zh: 我们评价大图尔上的M3GD,并显示增加预测的LiDAR包可以改进RGB和深度合成,比仅以图像为基础的版本更好.

This demonstrates that the learned conditioning generalizes across platforms, and establishes its practical relevance for robotic perception tasks.

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工程

blocks.en: II-A Generative Novel View Synthesis in Geometry-Aware Latents
blocks.zh: II-A 几何-智能Latents中的基因小说视图合成

blocks.en: Diffusion-based NVS initially matured around camera-conditioned image diffusion. Zero-1-to-3 [ 9 ] demonstrated that large pretrained 2D diffusion models encode viewpoint priors steerable by relative camera pose. SyncDreamer [ 10 ] improved multi-view consistency by denoising the joint distribution of target views. ZeroNVS [ 11 ] extended camera-conditioned priors from objects to full scenes. A second family couples generation with reconstruction: GeNVS [ 12 ] denoises through a latent 3D feature field, ReconFusion [ 25 ] regularizes per-scene NeRF optimization with a novel-view diffusion prior, and CAT3D [ 6 ] generates additional views for a downstream reconstruction pipeline. Although these methods introduce camera geometry, depth prediction, or internal 3D representations, their scene input remains a single modality: RGB images and their associated poses. They establish that generation suits target-view ambiguity, but provide no conditioning pathway for measurements or learned features from a physical 3D sensor.
blocks.zh: 基于扩散的NVS最初在相机条件的图像扩散周围成熟. Zero-1至3 [9] 演示了大型预训的2D传播模型编码前视位可被相对相机摆放. SyncDreamer [10] 通过取消联合分发目标视图,提高了多视图的一致性. ZeroNVS [11] 延长相机条件的前身从物体到全景. 第二代家庭夫妇通过重建:GENVS [12] denoises通过潜在的3D特征场,Reconfusion [25] 规范了每场NERF的优化,在新颖视角传播之前,CAT3D [6]为下游重建管道产生更多观点. 虽然这些方法引入了相机几何,深度预测,或内部的3D表示,但其场景输入仍然是一种单一模式:RGB图像及其相关姿态. 它们确定这一代适合目标-视野模糊,但没有为测量或从物理3D传感器学到的特性提供条件路径。

blocks.en: Closer to our work, some methods move generation into a geometry-aware space. MVGD [ 7 ] jointly generates target-view RGB and scale-consistent depth from images and corresponding poses via ray-conditioned multi-view geometric diffusion. GLD [ 8 ] goes further, diffusing directly in the frozen feature space of a geometric foundation model (DA3 [ 23 ] or VGGT [ 26 ] ) with a DiT-style transformer [ 27 , 28 ] trained under flow matching [ 29 , 30 ] . This latent space already encodes cross-view correspondence, and frozen decoders recover RGB and depth from synthesized latents. Crucially, GLD is an image-input-only baseline: it conditions on posed source RGB images and consumes no LiDAR or other measured 3D point cloud. Therefore, its geometric awareness comes from image-derived features rather than direct 3D sensor observations. M3GD retains GLD’s generative backbone but extends its conditioning from unimodal to multimodal, taking source RGB images together with projected features from measured 3D LiDAR point clouds. Our contribution is thus not another single-modality geometry-aware latent but a cross-modal conditioning method that lets 2D appearance and 3D measurements jointly condition latent-space generative NVS without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator.
blocks.zh: 更接近于我们的工作,一些方法将一代迁入一个几何感知空间. MVGD [7] 通过射线条件的多视线几何扩散,从图像和相应的姿势中联合生成目标-视图RGB和尺度一致的深度. GLD [8] 更进一步,直接在几何基模型(DA3 [23] 或VGGT [26])的冷冻特征空间中扩散,其DiT型变压器[27,28]在匹配[29,30]的流量下训练. 这个潜伏空间已经编码了交叉视图通信,被冻结的解码器从合成潜伏中恢复了RGB和深度. 关键是,GLD是一个只输入图像的基线:它以设置的源RGB图像为条件,不消耗LiDAR或其他测量到的3D点云. 因此,它的几何意识来自于图像衍生的特征,而不是直接的三维传感器观测. M3GD保留了GLD的基因骨干,但将其条件从单式延伸至多式,从测得的3D LiDAR点云中取出源RGB图像和预测特征. 因此,我们的贡献不是另一种单一模式的几何认识潜伏,而是一种跨模式的调节方法,它使2D的外观和3D的测量共同将潜在空间基因化的NVS作为条件,而不对跨模式翻译进行单独的预先训练。

blocks.en: II-B Generalizable Feed-Forward View Synthesis
blocks.zh: 二-B 概况 种子前导 查看综合

blocks.en: Deterministic feed-forward methods are the strongest non-generative baseline class for sparse-view synthesis. PixelNeRF [ 13 ] and CAT3D [ 6 ] condition NeRFs [ 31 ] on projected source-view features. MVSNeRF [ 32 ] and GeoNeRF [ 33 ] strengthen geometric reasoning with plane-swept cost volumes. The explicit branch predicts renderable primitives directly: pixelSplat [ 14 ] regresses 3D Gaussians [ 34 ] from image pairs, MVSplat [ 15 ] anchors Gaussian centers with a cost-volume prior, and DepthSplat [ 16 ] couples feed-forward splatting with a pretrained monocular depth backbone. Query-based reconstruction transformers [ 35 , 36 ] drop pixel alignment altogether. Trained on large multi-view datasets such as RealEstate10K [ 37 ] and DL3DV [ 38 ] , all these feed-forward models derive geometry solely from images, treating vision as the single input modality. None of the approaches consumes a pretrained point-cloud representation at inference time, and none produces both RGB and depth from a shared pretrained image latent. We compare against MVSplat and DepthSplat as representative deterministic competitors (Section VI ). In contrast, M3GD uses conditional diffusion in a shared image-latent space: rather than mapping RGB observations to a single renderable scene estimate, it iteratively denoises a target latent conditioned on both images and projected LiDAR foundation features. This generative formulation better suits sparse-view synthesis, where occlusions, disocclusions, and incomplete image geometry leave target appearance underdetermined: a learned visual prior resolves those ambiguities without forcing a single feed-forward regression, and mutually informed RGB and depth are decoded from the synthesized latent.
blocks.zh: 定型饲料前进法是稀有景色合成最强的非基因基线类. PixelNERF [13] 和 CAT3D [6] 条件 NERFs [31] 在预测的源视图特征上. MVSNERF[32]和GeoneNERF[33]用平面擦拭成本量加强几何推理. 显性分支直接预测可渲染的原始物:像素Splate[14]从图像对面递归3D高斯人[34],MVSplate[15]锚地高斯人中心前期成本量,深斯普莱特[16]夫妇饲料向上的镀层带有预先训练的单元深度骨干. 基于查询的重建变压器 [35,36] 完全放下像素对齐. 在RealEstate10K[37]和DL3DV[38]等大型多视图数据集上接受训练,所有这些向导模型都只从图像中得出几何,将视觉作为单一输入模式. 没有一个方法在推论时间消耗了事先经过训练的点云表示,没有一个方法从共同的事先经过训练的图像潜伏中产生RGB和深度。 我们比较MVSplat和DepthSplat作为具有代表性的决定性竞争者(第六节)。 相比之下,M3GD在共享的图像相对空间使用有条件的传播:它不是将RGB的观测结果映射到单一可渲染的场景估计,而是迭代地将一个既以图像为条件又以预测的LiDAR基础特征为条件的目标隐蔽. 这种基因配体更适合稀释-视觉合成,其中隔离,消散,和不完全的图像几何使目标外观没有确定:一个学习的视觉前期可以解决这些模糊性,而不会强迫一个单一的反馈-向后回归,相互知情的RGB和深度从合成的潜伏中解码.

blocks.en: II-C Depth and LiDAR Assisted View Synthesis
blocks.zh: II-C 深度和LiDAR 辅助视图合成

blocks.en: Robotic view synthesis supports policy evaluation, sensor-data augmentation, and viewpoint-flexible teleoperation, so sensor coverage and turnaround time are both operational concerns. VISTA 2.0 [ 1 ] synthesizes novel RGB, 3D LiDAR, and event-camera observations from recorded trajectories for closed-loop autonomous-driving experiments. Radiance Fields for Robotic Teleoperation [ 5 ] instead trains NeRF or Gaussian-splatting representations online from live robot data so operators can inspect viewpoints the physical cameras miss. These systems establish the robotics value of novel views, but also expose a practical distinction: fast rendering from a reconstructed scene does not remove the time needed to build or update the scene representation.
blocks.zh: 机器人视图合成支持政策评价、传感器数据增强和视线灵活远程操作,因此传感器覆盖和周转时间既是业务问题。 VISTA 2.0 [1]合成了新颖的RGB,3D LiDAR,以及从录制的轨迹中得出的事件-相机观测结果,用于闭路自动驾驶实验. 机器人远程操作的辐射场[5] 转而从活的机器人数据在线培训NERF或高斯电镀表示器,以便操作员检查观察器丢失的物理相机。 这些系统确立了新观点的机器人价值,但也暴露了一个实用的区别:从重建的场景中快速渲染并不能消除构建或更新场景表现所需的时间.

blocks.en: Most depth- and LiDAR-assisted rendering methods use geometry as supervision for per-scene optimization . DS-NeRF [ 17 ] supervises NeRF with sparse SfM depth, SparseNeRF [ 39 ] distills depth ranking from noisy sensors, and RegNeRF [ 40 ] and DiffusioNeRF [ 41 ] regularize unseen-view appearance and geometry. Urban Radiance Fields [ 18 ] adds LiDAR losses for street-level NeRFs. Robotics systems extend this to multimodal reconstruction: NeuSim [ 42 ] fuses camera and LiDAR to reconstruct objects for sensor simulation, SiLVR [ 43 ] uses range constraints to improve large-scale LiDAR–visual NeRF geometry in texture-poor regions, and PINGS [ 4 ] couples a LiDAR-derived distance field with a Gaussian-splatting radiance field for incremental robotic mapping. Despite differing representations, these approaches construct, optimize, or update an object- or environment-specific model before novel views can be queried.
blocks.zh: 大多数深度和LiDAR辅助渲染方法都使用几何作为每层场景优化的监督。 DS-NERF [17] 以稀疏的SfM深度监督NERF,SparseNERF [39] 从吵闹的传感器中蒸馏深度排名,RegNERF [40] 和DiffusioNERF [41] 规范无视外观和几何. 城市辐射场[18] 增加了街道一级NERFs的LiDAR损失. 机器人系统将这一损失扩展至多式联运重建:NeuSim [42] 引信相机和LiDAR用于重建用于传感器模拟的物体,SiLVR [43] 使用范围限制来改进纹理贫乏地区的大型LiDAR-视觉NERF几何,PINGS [4] 夫妇一个LiDAR衍生的距离场和一个高斯镀光场用于递增机器人绘图. 尽管表述方式不同,但这些方法在对新观点提出疑问之前,会构建、优化或更新一个针对对象或环境的模型。

blocks.en: Robotics also changes the input boundary: calibrated LiDAR is often a native observation rather than geometry inferred from images. The LiDAR-native NVS approaches such as NFL [ 44 ] , LiDAR-NeRF [ 45 ] , and LiDAR4D [ 46 ] synthesize LiDAR returns and emphasizes that LiDAR carries support structure destroyed when the sensor collapses into a single pseudo-depth map. Camera–LiDAR driving simulators such as UniSim [ 2 ] and NeuRAD [ 19 ] fuse both sensors to re-render driving scenes, but at the cost of per-scene optimization: each scene demands extra fitting before it can be queried, and the resulting representation is valid only for that scene. M3GD instead amortizes RGB–LiDAR fusion into a generalizable generative model and keeps LiDAR as a structured conditioning signal: it avoids scene-specific fitting at deployment and moves LiDAR from an optimization loss or output modality into a reusable conditioning signal, available on both source views and target-view geometric queries.
blocks.zh: 机器人也改变输入边界:校准的LiDAR往往是原生观测,而不是从图像推断出的几何. LiDAR-原生的NVS方法如NFL [44],LiDAR-NERF [45],和LiDAR4D [46]合成LiDAR返回,强调LiDAR携带的支撑结构在传感器崩溃成单一的伪深度地图时被破坏. 相机–LiDAR驱动UniSim[2]和Neurad[19]等模拟器将两个传感器都引信重置驾驶场景,但以每场景优化为代价:每个场景都需要额外装配后才能被询问,因此产生的表示只能对该场景有效. M3GD转而将RGB–LiDAR聚变分解成通俗的基因模型,并保持LiDAR作为结构化的调制信号:它避免了部署时的场景特异性装配,并将LiDAR从优化损失或输出模式移动到可重复使用的调制信号中,既可以在源视图上,也可以在目标视图几何查询上提供.

blocks.en: II-D Geometric-Aware Foundation Models and Data Alignment
blocks.zh: II-D 几何-智能基础模型和数据对齐

blocks.en: Collecting a task-specific robotics dataset requires synchronized, calibrated multimodal sensors across representative environments, limiting the scale and diversity available for training each robotic NVS model from scratch. Robotics representation learning therefore increasingly borrows from broader pretraining data. HRP [ 47 ] distills affordances from internet-scale human video into representations for robot learning. Geometric image foundation models transfer broad visual and geometric priors: DUSt3R [ 48 ] regresses dense pointmaps, VGGT [ 26 ] jointly predicts cameras, depth, and point tracks from many views, CUT3R [ 49 ] adds a persistent state for streaming 3D perception, and the Depth Anything series [ 50 , 23 ] provides robust transferable depth encoders. MapAnything [ 51 ] factorizes the reconstruction interface into rays, depth, pose, and scale, a perspective our asymmetric source/target packet design shares. On the 3D side, self-supervised point transformers [ 52 , 53 ] have culminated in Utonia [ 24 ] , a single point-cloud encoder across domains whose features have already proven useful for embodied reasoning. These 2D and 3D models offer complementary priors learned from far broader data than a single robot collection.
blocks.zh: 收集特定任务机器人数据集需要跨越代表性环境的同步,校准的多式传感器,从零开始限制每个机器人NVS模型可用于培训的规模和多样性. 因此,机器人代表学习越来越多地借用更广泛的培训前数据。 HRP[47]从互联网规模的人类视频中提炼出可供机器人学习的表示. 几何图像基础模型传输宽视和几何前兆: DUST3R [48] 递归密度点图,VGGT [26] 联合预测相机,深度,以及来自许多观点的点轨,CUT3R [49] 为流传的3D感知增加了一个持续状态,深度任意号系列[50,23]提供了强大的可转移深度编码器. Map anything [51] 将重建界面的因素化为射线、深度、布置和尺度,这是我们不对称的源/目标包设计共享的视角。 在3D方面,自我监督的点变压器[52,53]已经达到了Utonia[24]的高潮,这是一个跨越多个域的单一点云编码器,其特征已被证明对体现推理有用. 这些2D和3D模型提供了比单个机器人收集要广泛得多的数据所学得的补充前科.

blocks.en: Our alignment study connects these families. Representation-similarity tools such as linear CKA [ 54 ] and SVCCA [ 55 ] typically compare networks trained on the same modality. We adress the cross-modality challenge by comparing projected Utonia LiDAR features against DA3 and DINOv2 [ 56 ] image features on spatially overlapping grids. To our knowledge, the substantial shared spatial structure we observe between independently trained 2D and 3D foundation encoders (Section VI-A ), and its use for generative NVS, have not been reported before.
blocks.zh: 我们的校正研究将这些家庭联系起来。 代表性-相似性工具,如线性CKA[54]和SVCCA[55]一般比较以同一模式培训的网络。 我们通过将预测的Utonia LiDAR特征与DA3和DINov2[56]图像特征在空间重叠网格上进行比较,来应对跨模式性挑战。 据我们所知,我们观测到的、经过独立培训的2D和3D基础编码器之间的实质性共享空间结构(第VI-A节)及其用于遗传性NVS的情况以前从未报告过。

blocks.en: This emergent structure differs from works that learn image–point alignment explicitly. Cross-modal distillation methods such as PPKT [ 57 ] , SLidR [ 20 ] , Seal [ 58 ] , OpenScene [ 21 ] , and CLIP2Scene [ 22 ] supervise a 3D encoder to reproduce 2D (often CLIP) features, showing that alignment can be engineered. Robotics methods pursue similar engineered fusion mechanisms: SGR [ 59 ] combines semantics from a pretrained 2D model with depth-based 3D spatial reasoning, while F3RM [ 60 ] distills pretrained image features into a scene-specific 3D feature field for manipulation. We study a complementary question: whether two off-the-shelf encoders trained separately on different modalities and broader pretraining corpora already share enough structure to be composed after projection. This is consistent with the Platonic Representation Hypothesis [ 61 ] that models trained on different data and objectives converge toward a shared world representation, and gives it a concrete robotics test: if projected 3D features share spatial structure with the image latent, a robot can borrow complementary 2D and 3D priors through a lightweight learned conditioning pathway rather than pretrain a new aligned representation from limited task data. Relative to both geometric foundation models and explicit image–point distillation, our contribution is twofold: we measure zero-shot 2D–3D representation similarity after projection, and turn that observation into an NVS conditioning method instead of separately pretraining an aligned encoder.
blocks.zh: 这种新兴结构与学习图像的作品不同——明确点对齐. PPKT[57],SLidR[20],封印[58],OpenScene[21],CLIP2Scene[22]等跨式蒸馏方法监督一个3D编码器复制2D(常为CLIP)特性,显示对齐可以进行工程. 机器人方法追求类似的工程化聚变机制: SGR [59] 将来自预训2D模型的语义学与深度3D空间推理相结合,而F3RM [60] 将预训图像特征蒸馏成场景特定的3D特征场进行操纵. 我们研究了一个补充问题:两个现成编码器是否在不同的模式和更广泛的培训前公司分别受过培训,在预测后是否已经拥有足够的结构。 这符合 " Platonic Presentation Phypothesis " [61],即不同数据和目标培训的模型趋同于共享的世界代表,并给它一个具体的机器人测试:如果预测的3D特征与图像潜伏的空间结构相同,机器人可以通过轻量级的学习调节路径借用互补的2D和3D前身,而不是从有限的任务数据中预选新的对齐代表. 相对于几何基础模型和清晰的图像-点衍射,我们的贡献是双重的:我们在投影后测量0射2D-3D的表示相似性,并将观测结果转化为NVS调节方法,而不是单独预训一个对齐的编码器.

blocks.en: In our work, the conditioning variable y y contains the source images, camera geometry, and projected LiDAR packets. The model therefore does not hallucinate a scene from scratch: it learns a conditional vector field that moves an initially random target-view latent toward the latent consistent with the robot’s observations, and the conditioning variable guides that field.
blocks.zh: 在我们的作品中,调制变量yy包含源图像,相机几何,以及投影的LiDAR包. 因此,模型不会从零开始对一个场景产生幻觉:它学习到一个有条件的矢量场,这个矢量场将最初的随机目标视图潜移到与机器人观测一致的潜伏中,而条件变量则引导着这个场景.

blocks.en: III-C 2D and 3D Foundation Feature Backbones
blocks.zh: 三-C 2D和3D基金会

blocks.en: M3GD composes a dense image-latent backbone with a sparse point-cloud backbone.
blocks.zh: M3GD以稀疏的点云骨干构成密集的图像相对主干.

blocks.en: On the 2D side, DA3 [ 23 ] is a visual-geometry foundation model predicting spatially consistent geometry from one or more visual inputs, with or without known camera poses. M3GD uses not its final depth prediction but the encoded dense image-token representation learned before decoding. Specifically, the encoder maps each image to a spatial feature grid whose cells stay aligned with local image regions, and its depth, ray, and multi-view objectives make those cells geometry-aware as well as appearance-aware.
blocks.zh: 在2D方面,DA3[23]是一个视觉几何基础模型,从一个或多个视觉输入中预测空间一致性几何,无论有无已知的相机姿势. M3GD不使用其最后的深度预测,而是使用解码前学到的编码稠密的图像脚本表示. 具体地说,编码器将每个图像映射到一个空间特征网格上,其细胞与局部图像区域保持一致,其深度,射线和多视图目标使得这些细胞几何感知以及外观感知.

blocks.en: These properties motivate our use of DA3 as the image-side latent space for integrating projected point-cloud features, a choice we validate against alternative image backbones in Section VI-A2 .
blocks.zh: 这些特性促使我们利用DA3作为图像侧面的潜在空间,以整合预测的点-云特性,我们在第六节A2中对照替代图像主干线验证这一选择。

blocks.en: On the 3D side, Utonia [ 24 ] is a self-supervised point transformer [ 52 , 53 ] trained as a single encoder across heterogeneous point-cloud domains including indoor and outdoor scenes, with no image-feature distillation or other image supervision. This breadth matters for robotic perception because raw point clouds differ sharply in scale, density, sampling pattern, coordinate convention, and optional auxiliary channels such as color or normals. Utonia learns geometry-first per-point descriptors that remain useful across domains rather than specializing to one sensor family. Given a LiDAR sweep P P , the frozen encoder maps each 3D point to a learned feature attached to its metric location, written E Utonia ​ ( P ) \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{Utonia}}(P) .
blocks.zh: 在3D方面,Utonia[24]是一个自我监督的点变压器[52,53],作为单一编码器在包括室内和室外场景在内的各种点云域中培训,没有图像特性的蒸馏或其他图像监督. 这种宽度对于机器人的感知很重要,因为原始点云在尺度,密度,采样模式,协调会议,以及色彩或正常等可选辅助通道上都存在显著差异. Utonia学习了几何-每点第一描述符,这些描述符在各个领域仍然有用,而不是专门用于一个传感器家族。 由于LiDAR扫描了P P,被冷冻的编码器地图每个3D都指向其标尺位置所附的学习特征,写着E Utonia (P)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{Utonia}}(P).

blocks.zh: 四. 方法

blocks.en: IV-A Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en: M3GD composes 2D and 3D representations through a projected RGB–LiDAR conditioning pathway (Fig. 1 ). The frozen DA3 encoder maps the RGB image I I to an H × W H{\times}W latent grid z z , the space in which the inherited GLD backbone generates novel views. In parallel, the frozen Utonia encoder assigns a descriptor to every point of the LiDAR sweep P P , and the camera projection π \pi pools these descriptors into the cells of a second grid h h with the same layout. Every cell q q thus pairs an image latent z q z_{q} with a geometry descriptor h q h_{q} , while cells without LiDAR support (hatched) carry h q = 𝟎 h_{q}=\mathbf{0} ; camera projection alone supplies this correspondence, with neither backbone fine-tuned. Each view-aligned LiDAR packet extends h h with explicit geometry statistics from the same projected points, and a lightweight residual adapter mixes it into the DA3 grid cell by cell, exposing spatially indexed 3D evidence to the generator while keeping the GLD image latent space, decoders, camera conditioning, and training objective unchanged (Fig. 2 ). Section VI-A later evaluates whether the frozen image features and projected point-cloud features share measurable spatial structure on this common support. We first specify the inherited GLD backbone and M3GD’s operating point (Section IV-B ), then present the three parts of our method: a projected RGB–LiDAR representation (Section IV-C ), residual LiDAR conditioning (Section IV-D ), and flow-matching training with a configurable inference-step budget (Section IV-E ). Concrete dimensions, channel definitions, and training hyperparameters are isolated in Section V-A .

Because the frozen encoder can deterministically propagate a shallower feature map to deeper levels, generation needs only to cover the hierarchy up to a chosen boundary level. This avoids a second generative stage and places LiDAR conditioning at the latent level directly synthesized by the model; the representation analysis in Section VI-A also identifies level 0 0 as the strongest overall match to projected Utonia features. Section VI-E quantifies the deployment cost of synthesizing the deeper level.

Target-view LiDAR as a geometric query. A target packet is computed by exactly the procedure above: sweep selection, projection, and eqs. ( 6 )–( 8 ) do not depend on whether the view is a source or a target. What differs is how the packet enters the model. A source packet is mixed with the view’s image latent, whereas a target view has no image latent, so its packet is the only observation-dependent conditioning of that view (Section IV-D ).
The construction therefore assumes only that the platform’s LiDAR stream covers the queried timestamp,
On the robot (Section VI-F ), it is the sweep nearest the query timestamp on the logged stream. The query is appearance-free by construction, since the explicit channels are computed from projected point locations alone and Utonia receives only 3D coordinates. Nor does it hand over the depth output: the packet lives on the coarse H × W H{\times}W grid and is empty wherever no point projects, whereas D j tgt D^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{j} is required at every pixel (Section V-A ).

blocks.en: The adapter is intentionally local and lightweight, so it cannot by itself solve cross-view reasoning. Whatever use is made of the packets’ spatial structure must happen inside the existing multi-view attention. This keeps the conditioning pathway minimal and makes the ablations of Section VI interpretable as statements about what the generative model extracts from the packets, not about adapter capacity. The same consideration motivates the Zero control of Section VI-D2 , which keeps the adapter but removes LiDAR content.

During training, the camera conditioning and the LiDAR packets are independently replaced by their null values with probability 0.1 0.1 each, following Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). We fine-tune from the released GLD checkpoint with AdamW for 50 50 k optimization steps at global batch size 32 32 , constant learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} , bf16 precision, EMA decay 0.9995 0.9995 , and the independent camera and LiDAR conditioning dropout of Section IV-E . blocks.en: Dataset. We use GrandTour [ 66 ] , an ANYmal-D quadruped carrying the Boxi sensor payload that traverses indoor facilities, urban outdoor scenes, and natural terrain. GrandTour suits M3GD on three counts. Its Boxi payload provides the hardware-synchronized, calibrated camera–LiDAR streams and reliable poses (RTK-GNSS and total-station tracking) that packet construction requires; as the largest open-access legged-robotics dataset, it offers the scale for fine-tuning and the environment diversity our evaluation draws from; and its ego-centric 6-DoF viewpoints match our deployment setting (Section V-D ), whereas driving datasets such as nuScenes [ 67 ] pair camera and LiDAR only under near-planar road motion and internet-scale NVS collections provide no LiDAR at all. We use the three HDR cameras (front, left, right) and the motion-undistorted Hesai LiDAR. We train and evaluate in temporal mode, where source and target views are sampled from a single camera stream. Packet construction and view-sampling details follow Section V-A .

blocks.en: As GrandTour provides no official train/evaluation split, we partition its 48 48 recordings into 40 40 for training and 8 8 for evaluation, with no recording overlap between the two splits . Training uses all three HDR cameras (front, left, right) and the LiDAR; evaluation uses the front camera and LiDAR only, with two conditioning and two target views per clip and 300 300 clips sampled per recording ( 2,400 2{,}400 clips in total). Each target view may use its co-located LiDAR observation as the LiDAR query defined in Section IV-C . The target RGB image is never provided to the model. The evaluation recordings span eight representative scenarios, namely ice cave, alpine snow, urban plaza, forest, industrial bunker, warehouse/garage, railway, and construction, yielding a diverse benchmark that stresses both texture-rich and geometry-dominant settings.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We assess synthesized views along three axes: 2D appearance, 2D geometry (depth), and 3D reconstruction. All metrics are computed on target views only, since source views are model inputs, and are averaged over the target views of the 2,400 2{,}400 evaluation clips at a fixed seed. Where noted, we additionally report a hard subset of n = 1,407 n{=}1{,}407 clips whose maximum camera baseline between views exceeds 1 1 m. For appearance, we report PSNR, SSIM [ 68 ] , and LPIPS [ 69 ] on the rendered RGB. For depth, GrandTour provides no dense ground-truth depth, and several baselines emit no depth at all, so we evaluate all methods through a single frozen estimator: each rendered target view I ^ j tgt \hat{I}^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{j} is re-encoded by the frozen DA3 encoder E DA3 \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{DA3}} and decoded by the DPT head (Section V-A ), and we compare DPT ⁡ ( E DA3 ​ ( I ^ j tgt ) ) \mathrm{DPT}(\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{DA3}}(\hat{I}^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{j})) against the pseudo-ground truth DPT ⁡ ( E DA3 ​ ( I j tgt ) ) \mathrm{DPT}(\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{DA3}}(I^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{j})) using absolute relative error (AbsRel), RMSE, and the inlier ratio δ < 1.25 \delta{<}1.25 [ 70 ] . blocks.en: VI-A Projected 2D–3D Representation Compatibility
blocks.zh: 预计2D-3D代表兼容性

blocks.en: Having established M3GD’s projected LiDAR conditioning pathway, we test its representation-level premise: whether independently trained image and point-cloud foundation encoders organize corresponding scene regions similarly after camera projection. Projection places both representations on the same image-latent grid, so corresponding cells describe the same scene region; however, the feature vectors at those cells live in independently learned spaces of different dimensions and need not be similar in any coordinate-wise sense. Utonia is pretrained purely on point clouds, with no image-feature distillation or other image supervision (Section III-C ), so any measured compatibility with DA3 emerges without explicit image–point alignment training.
blocks.zh: 在设定了 M3GD 预测的 LiDAR 配置路径后, 我们测试了它的表示级别前提: 独立训练的图像和点云基础编码器是否在镜头投影后同样组织相应的场景区域 。 投影将两种表示都置于相同的图像相对网格上,因此对应的细胞描述的是同一个场景区域;然而,这些细胞的特征矢量生活在不同维度的独立学习空间中,在任何坐标的意义上都不需要相似. Utonia 完全在点云上预先训练,没有图像特性的蒸馏或其他图像监督(第三节-C节),因此,任何测量到的与DA3的兼容性都会出现,而没有明确的图像-点对齐训练。

blocks.en: We evaluate three comparison groups. First, DA3-Base levels 0 0 – 3 3 are compared against Utonia to measure level-wise compatibility. Second, DA3-Base level- 0 0 –Utonia is compared against DINOv2–Utonia and VGGT–Utonia to test whether DA3 is more or less compatible with Utonia than alternative image backbones. Third, DA3-Base level- 0 0 –Utonia is compared with DA3-Base level- 0 0 –DINOv2, which provides an image-only reference scale rather than a competing conditioning signal.

blocks.en: For ρ PCA \rho_{\mathrm{PCA}} , we independently project each representation in each image to three local PCA components, align the pseudo-color coordinates with orthogonal Procrustes, and report their mean channel correlation. This diagnostic summarizes low-dimensional spatial consensus rather than raw-feature equivalence. On the same supported cells before PCA, we compute linear CKA [ 54 ] , mean SVCCA correlation over up to 20 20 available directions [ 55 ] , Jaccard@ 10 10 agreement between cosine-nearest-neighbor sets, and the correlation ρ aff \rho_{\mathrm{aff}} between pairwise cosine-affinity matrices. blocks.en: VI-A 2 Findings
blocks.zh: VI-A 2 调查结果

blocks.en: DA3-Base level- 0 0 is the most compatible feature level. Among the DA3-Base hierarchy, level- 0 0 shows the strongest overall compatibility with projected Utonia features. It achieves the highest CKA and SVCCA- 20 20 , while ranking second on PCA channel correlation, Jaccard@ 10 10 , and affinity correlation. Although higher levels are competitive on isolated low-dimensional or neighborhood diagnostics, their raw-feature-space alignment is weaker, especially in CKA. This result is consistent with conditioning M3GD at level 0 0 .
blocks.zh: DA3-Base级别 - 0是最兼容的特性级别. 在DA3-Base等级中,0级显示与预测的Utonia特征最强的整体兼容性. 它实现了最高的CKA和SVCCA - 20 20,同时在PCA频道关联性,Jaccard@ 10 10,以及亲和性关联性上排名第二. 虽然更高水平在孤立的低维或邻里诊断上具有竞争力,但其原始地貌与空间的对齐性较弱,尤其是在CKA. 这个结果与0级的M3GD条件一致.

blocks.en: DA3 is the strongest tested image-side match to Utonia. Under the same grid and LiDAR-supported cells, DA3-Base level- 0 0 obtains the highest CKA, SVCCA- 20 20 , Jaccard@ 10 10 , and affinity correlation among the image backbones compared against Utonia. The PCA visualizations in Fig. 4 likewise show that projected Utonia and DA3 features often partition co-located scene regions similarly. These results place DA3 ahead of DINOv2 and VGGT for the tested Utonia pairing.
blocks.zh: DA3是测试中最强的图像侧对阵乌托尼亚. 在同一网格和LiDAR支持的细胞下,DA3-Base级0得到最高的CKA,SVCCA-20 20,Jaccard@10 10,与Utonia相比,图像骨干之间的亲和关系. 图4中的五氯苯甲醚可视化也表明,预测的Utonia和DA3特征往往类似地位于同一地点。 这些结果将DA3排在DINOv2和VGGT之前,用于测试的Utonia配对.

blocks.en: Cross-modal similarity is substantial but not image–image equivalence. As expected, the image-only DA3-Base level- 0 0 –DINOv2 reference is stronger than the cross-modal DA3-Base level- 0 0 –Utonia pair on most raw-feature diagnostics, including CKA, SVCCA- 20 20 , and affinity correlation. The cross-modal pair nevertheless remains on the same broad scale and slightly exceeds the image-only reference on Jaccard@ 10 10 . We therefore interpret the evidence as shared spatial and geometric structure between the tested independently trained encoders, not coordinate-wise feature equivalence.
blocks.zh: 跨模式相似性是实质性的,但不是图像-图像等同性。 如预期,仅图像 DA3-Base 级别 - 0 – DINOv2 引用比跨模式 DA3-Base 级别 - 更强 0 – Utonia 配对在大多数原始特征诊断上,包括 CKA, SVCCA - 20 20,以及亲缘关系. 然而,交叉模式的对价仍然维持在同样的大尺度上,略高于Jaccard@10 10上只提及图像的参考值。 因此,我们把证据解释为经过测试的独立培训编码器之间的共享空间和几何结构,而不是协调的特征等同。

blocks.en: Implication. These findings support the representation-compatibility premise underlying M3GD and are consistent with exposing projected Utonia features to the generator at DA3-Base level- 0 0 . M3GD does not separately pretrain a cross-modal translator or introduce an auxiliary alignment objective; its residual adapter is learned end-to-end through the NVS objective. Representation compatibility and downstream utility are separate questions: the baseline comparison (Section VI-B ) and the mechanism ablations (Section VI-D2 ) test whether real projected LiDAR packets improve synthesis beyond adapter capacity alone.
blocks.zh: 释义. 这些结论支持M3GD所依据的表示兼容性前提,并与DA3-Base级别0-0向生成器暴露预计的Utonia特征是一致的. M3GD不单独预演跨模式翻译或引入辅助对齐目标;其剩余适配器是通过NVS目标学习的端到端. 表示兼容性和下游效用是不同的问题:基线比较(第六-B节)和机制放大(第六-D2节)检验真实预测的LiDAR包是否仅能改善适配器能力的合成。

blocks.en: Inference cost. Table IV reports the sampling cost of the diffusion methods. M3GD is not only the most accurate method in Table II but also the cheapest to run, with the lowest latency and the lowest peak reserved memory of all diffusion methods. The cleanest comparison is against GLD, which shares M3GD’s resolution and sampling budget: M3GD is 1.7 × 1.7{\times} faster and uses 33 % 33\% less memory, largely because GLD’s native two-stage cascade evaluates the denoiser twice per sampling step whereas M3GD samples in a single pass. Matrix3D and MVGenMaster run in their original configurations at higher resolutions ( 512 × 512 512{\times}512 and 384 × 576 384{\times}576 against 336 × 224 336{\times}224 ), and Matrix3D additionally samples once per target view; even so, M3GD is 7.6 × 7.6{\times} faster than Matrix3D, matches MVGenMaster’s latency within run-to-run variation, and uses roughly 40 % 40\% less memory than either. The reported M3GD latency is moreover conservative: it includes projecting the target-view LiDAR and running the frozen Utonia encoder, both of which execute once per clip and amortize over all M M target views. In a streaming deployment the packet can be computed as the scan arrives rather than at query time, lowering the per-query cost further.

VI-D Mechanism Ablations
blocks.zh: VI-D机制

blocks.en: Our mechanism ablations examine three questions: whether LiDAR conditioning helps across training modes (Section VI-D1 ), whether the gain requires real per-sample LiDAR content rather than merely the added conditioning pathway, and which part of the packet carries the signal (both in Section VI-D2 ). We keep these ablations separate from deployment-recipe choices (Section VI-E ).
blocks.zh: 我们的机制模拟研究了三个问题:LiDAR调节是否有助于跨培训模式(第VI-D1节),收益是否需要真实的每个样本LiDAR内容,而不仅仅是附加的调节路径,以及包中哪些部分带有信号(都在第VI-D2节)。 我们把这些杂乱无章地与部署-后备选择分开(第六节E节)。

blocks.en: VI-D 1 LiDAR Conditioning and Training Mode
blocks.zh: LiDAR 条件和培训模式

blocks.en: Table V reports appearance quality as we vary the training mode and LiDAR conditioning. The freeze/no-LiDAR row is therefore not directly comparable to the GLD row of Table II ( 17.39 17.39 vs. 17.92 17.92 ), which runs GLD’s native two-stage cascade. Three findings stand out. First, LiDAR conditioning improves every metric in every training mode, with per-mode PSNR gains ranging from + 0.63 +0.63 to + 1.72 +1.72 dB; projected LiDAR geometry is thus a consistently useful signal for synthesis. Second, the gain is largest under the freeze setting ( + 1.72 +1.72 dB PSNR, + 0.054 +0.054 SSIM, − 0.074 -0.074 LPIPS), where the backbone is fixed and only the LiDAR adapter is trainable. Because the frozen backbone cannot adapt its appearance representation, this improvement is attributable to the LiDAR signal itself rather than to added model capacity, cleanly isolating LiDAR’s contribution. Third, LiDAR does not substitute for backbone adaptation: although it lifts the frozen model substantially ( → 19.11 17.39\!\rightarrow\!19.11 PSNR), the absolute quality stays well below the trained variants, so the strongest results still require updating the backbone. Among the trained modes, fine-tuning from the pretrained GLD checkpoint slightly outperforms training from scratch ( 22.22 22.22 vs. 22.16 22.16 PSNR with LiDAR), and scoring the loss on the target views only, rather than on all jointly denoised views ( tgt-only ), gives a further improvement ( 22.27 22.27 ). Training the LiDAR branch with classifier-free dropout adds a final increment, yielding our best configuration at 22.33 / 0.549 / 0.283 22.33\,/\,0.549\,/\,0.283 (PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS). We therefore adopt fine-tuning with a target-only loss and classifier-free LiDAR conditioning as our default recipe.

blocks.en: Table VI separates the effect of the LiDAR packet content from the effect of the added conditioning pathway. To sharpen the comparison, this ablation is evaluated on the hard subset (Section V-B ): a large camera baseline implies substantial ego-motion within the clip, which is precisely the regime where projected LiDAR conditioning has room to act. Each row is a separately trained model under the default recipe (multi-step, target-only fine-tune, classifier-free LiDAR). Only the LiDAR input supplied during training and evaluation changes. Two controls remove per-sample content at different strengths: Zero feeds all-zero packets, so the LiDAR pathway receives no signal and effectively never trains, whereas Learnable param replaces the packet with a shared, data-independent learned tensor of the same shape—a capacity-matched control whose input pathway does train but which carries no per-sample information. Geom-only zeroes the learned 3D foundation feature (Utonia), isolating the hand-crafted geometric statistics.

blocks.en:
Generalization across scene types. Fig. 6 shows M3GD predictions with examples ordered from indoor scenes through semi-open structures to outdoor environments. Across this range, the synthesized views preserve dominant geometric structures—walls, ground planes, rails, shelves, corridors, vehicles, and vegetation—while inferring plausible appearance from only two source images. This behavior is consistent with the intended role of the target-view LiDAR conditioning packet as a geometric anchor: the predicted layout remains stable even where the sparse and sometimes ambiguous source observations constrain appearance only weakly. Remaining artifacts concentrate around fine structures, reflective regions, and dynamic objects, precisely where that constraint is weakest.
Nevertheless, the synthesized target views remain geometrically coherent in challenging indoor, semi-open, and outdoor robot-captured scenes, supporting the quantitative improvements reported in Table II .
blocks.zh:
场景类型通用. 图6显示了M3GD的预测,并举例说明通过半开放结构从室内场景到室外环境的顺序。 在这个范围内,综合观点保留了主要的几何结构——墙、地面飞机、铁路、货架、走廊、车辆和植被——同时从仅有两个来源的图像中推断出可信的外观。 这种行为与目标视图LiDARcure package作为几何锚的预期作用是一致的:即使稀疏且有时模棱两可的源头观测只能弱化地限制外观,预测的布局仍然保持稳定. 剩余的文物集中在精细的结构、反射区和动态物体上,正是这种限制最弱的地方。
尽管如此,综合目标观点在挑战室内、半开放式和室外机器人捕捉场景方面仍保持几何一致性,支持表二所报告的数量改进。

blocks.en:
Effect of LiDAR conditioning. Fig. 7 isolates the contribution of target-view LiDAR conditioning on examples with large source–target viewpoint changes, in which target-facing walls, road regions, vehicles, shelves, and open corridors are only weakly visible, or invisible, in the source views. In this regime, the image-only GLD ∗† baseline often synthesizes plausible but incorrectly placed content, reflecting the ambiguity of inferring the target view from RGB observations alone. The LiDAR columns of the figure show the signal that resolves this ambiguity: the raw projection of the target-view sweep carries the geometry available at the queried pose, and its downsampled form on the image-latent grid is the compact version the packet delivers to the model. Conditioned on this signal, the geom-only variant already recovers the dominant target-view structure more accurately than the image-only baseline, confirming that the explicit geometry statistics act as a geometric anchor. Geometry alone, however, does not resolve appearance: geom-only outputs can still miss texture, material detail, and fine object appearance. The full packet closes this gap by adding the downsampled Utonia descriptors, yielding sharper local details such as boxes, walls, road surfaces, vegetation, and vehicles.
This qualitative behavior is consistent with the LiDAR conditioning ablations in Table VI .

blocks.en: VI-E Deployment Recipe Ablations

blocks.en: After the ablations isolate why the RGB–LiDAR representation helps, we choose the practical operating point for robot deployment: the Euler integration-step budget K K and the number M M of jointly synthesized target views. These recipe choices are not the main scientific claim, they fix the quality–cost trade-off under the deployment budget. The level- 0 0 design itself is a stated choice of Section IV , motivated by the alignment result and the deployment budget and Table VII supports it from the cost side. The resulting quality, latency, and memory scaling across integration-step and target-view counts are reported in Section VI-G .

blocks.en: VI-F Real-World Robot Deployment
blocks.zh: VI-F 实际世界机器人部署

blocks.en: The ablations above isolate the mechanism on held-out recordings. We close by exercising the full conditioning pathway in the loop on a physical robot, in exactly the regime Section III-A describes. The Warthog platform of Section V-D (Fig. 3 ) drives a route while logging its camera and LiDAR streams. To synthesize the view at a chosen pose along the traversal, we take a short window of past, time-aligned camera–LiDAR pairs as conditioning views, project the LiDAR sweep temporally nearest the target query’s timestamp into the target view to form the target packet (Section IV-C , no target RGB is used), and predict the target-view RGB and depth with the same flow model used in the aforementioned experiments. We emphasize that this model is deployed as is: it is trained on GrandTour only and is neither retrained nor fine-tuned on any data from the Warthog, so the deployment is a zero-shot transfer to a new robot platform, sensor suite, and environment. The representative outputs shown below use K = 10 K{=}10 Euler integration steps. Every input the model needs is a byproduct of the robot’s normal operation, available at the moment it needs the synthesized view.

blocks.en: The two selected queries, Q1 and Q2, lie on a wooded portion of the route about half a minute apart; each predicts RGB and depth at two held-out poses, T1 and T2, logged two seconds apart, from two conditioning views recorded within a few meters of them. Unlike the benchmark recordings, these inputs contain deployment artifacts visible in the projected point clouds, including LiDAR shadows caused by viewpoint occulsion and residual camera-LiDAR misalignment due to imperfect temporal synchronization. Fig. 8 shows the outputs. Nevertheless, they reproduce the behavior observed on held-out GrandTour recordings: the synthesized views follow the requested camera poses, and the decoded depth preserves the dominant layout supported by the projected LiDAR, including the ground plane, tree trunks, and large background structure. The point of this demonstration is not a new aggregate metric or controlled robustness benchmark. It is evidence that the conditioning signal required by M3GD is available from the synchronized camera–LiDAR stream of a physical robot, remains useful in the presence of ordinary sensing artifacts, and transfers to a previously unseen platform and sensor configuration without any target-domain retraining.
blocks.zh: 两个选定的查询,Q1和Q2,分别位于路由的木质部分,相距约半分钟;每个都预言RGB和深度在T1和T2两个悬浮姿势上,记录在两秒之外,而记录在其中几米之内的两个调制视图. 与基准录制不同,这些输入包含在预测点云中可见的部署文物,包括视线占用导致的LiDAR阴影和剩余相机-LiDAR因时间同步不完善导致的错配. 图8显示了产出。 尽管如此,它们还是转载了被搁置的GrandTour录音中观察到的行为:合成的视图遵循了所请求的相机姿势,解码深度保留了被预测的LiDAR支持的主导布局,包括地面平面,树干,以及大背景结构. 这一示范的重点不是一个新的总度或可控强性基准。 有证据表明,M3GD所需的调制信号可以从物理机器人的同步相机-LiDAR流中获取,在普通感知文物存在时仍然有用,并且转移至一个以前不为人知的平台和传感器配置,而没有任何目标领域再培训。

blocks.en: For K = 10 K=10 , N = 2 N=2 , M = 2 M=2 , M3GD peaks at 5.80 5.80 GiB and spans 4.22 4.22 – 6.50 6.50 GiB across the sweep. The step sweep demonstrates an inference-budget trade-off, where a single Euler step gives the lowest M3GD latency ( 3.13 3.13 s for two targets), but its LPIPS degrades to 0.889 0.889 . Five steps raise PSNR to 15.86 15.86 dB and SSIM to 0.281 0.281 , reduce LPIPS to 0.480 0.480 , and require 3.63 3.63 s, while additional steps increase latency without improving the appearance metrics on this route. Jointly synthesizing more targets increases total latency and memory, but amortizes computation: for M3GD at K = 10 K{=}10 , latency per target falls from 2.13 2.13 s at M = 2 M{=}2 to 1.21 1.21 s at M = 4 M{=}4 . Thus when a robot requires multiple queried views from the same source context, M3GD can reuse shared computation, such as LiDAR encoding, across targets rather than paying a full generation cost for each view.

blocks.en: Together, Tables IV and VII support complementary claims. Table IV shows that LiDAR conditioning does not require a heavier diffusion architecture: M3GD achieves its evaluation gains while avoiding GLD’s multi-stage cascade. Notably, LiDAR conditioning shifts computational cost upfront and yields substantial savings when predicting multiple views. Table VII shows that the same M3GD design provides selectable quality, latency, and memory operating points.
blocks.zh: 表四和表七加在一起支持补充索赔。 表四显示,LiDAR调制不需要更重的传播架构:M3GD在避免GLD的多级级级联的同时实现了评价收益. 值得注意的是,LiDAR将转换计算成本提前,并在预测多种观点时产生大量节余。 表七显示,相同的M3GD设计提供了可选择的质量,耐久性和内存操作点.

blocks.en: VII Limitations and Future Works
blocks.zh: 七. 限制和未来工程

blocks.en: Temporal staleness. M3GD selects the LiDAR sweep nearest each image timestamp, but the current evaluation does not isolate the effect of camera–LiDAR delay. A controlled time-offset ablation and explicit modeling of timing uncertainty inside the generative network can be interesting future directions to explore.
blocks.zh: 时节沉闷. M3GD选择LiDAR扫描最接近的每个图像时间戳,但当前评价并不隔离相机–LiDAR延迟的效果. 在基因网络内对时间不确定性进行可控的时断时断和明确的模型化,可能是值得探索的未来方向。

blocks.en: Per-cell averaging mixes surfaces. Pooling all points that project into a latent cell averages across depth layers near object boundaries and thin structures. Front-surface-only pooling, depth-sorted visibility weighting, or multi-layer packets are natural refinements. We deliberately kept the residual adapter minimal to make the ablations attributable.
blocks.zh: 每个细胞平均混合表面. 将所有投影点汇集到一个跨深度层的潜伏细胞平均值中,靠近物体边界和薄结构. 前表面独聚,深度分辨权重,或多层包是自然的完善. 我们故意把剩余适配器减到最低 才能把擦伤归咎于你

blocks.en: Scale and scope of evaluation. Both the NVS benchmark and the representation study use GrandTour recordings from one robot platform (ANYmal-D). Extending the evaluation to wide-baseline cross-camera synthesis, other platforms, and driving datasets would probe how far the measured DA3–Utonia structure transfers across domains; the packet interface itself is platform-agnostic. We will release our code and evaluation protocols to facilitate these extensions. The comparison against feed-forward splatting baselines is matched in fine-tuning data but cannot perfectly equalize pretraining corpora across methods.
blocks.zh: 评价的规模和范围。 NVS基准和表示研究都使用一个机器人平台(ANYmal-D)的GrandTour录音. 将评价范围扩大到宽底线跨相机合成、其他平台和驱动数据集,将探究所测量的DA3-Utonia结构跨域转移的深度;数据包接口本身是平台不可知的。 我们将发布我们的代码和评价协议,以便利这些扩展。 与饲料向上镀层基线的比较与微调数据相匹配,但不能完全将各种方法的预先训练公司等同起来。

blocks.en: Dynamic scenes. Packets assume the time-nearest sweep describes the scene at the image timestamp. Fast-moving objects violate this even at small Δ ​ t \Delta t ; neither the packet schema (beyond the variance channel) nor the model addresses object motion explicitly.
blocks.zh: 动态场景. Packets假设最接近的扫描在图像时间戳上描述了现场. 快速移动的物体即使在小的 QQ t \ Delta t 中也违反此规定; 包子计划( 超越差异通道) 和模型都没有明确地处理对象运动 。

blocks.en: Inference budget and deployment hardware. Reducing the Euler integration budget lowers latency, but single-step sampling substantially degrades LPIPS on the deployment route. The reported runtimes were measured on a robot equipped with an RTX A6000 as described in Section V-D , so they should not be interpreted as guaranteed real-time performance on smaller onboard computers. Adaptive solvers and accelerated flow sampling are promising directions for improving this quality–cost trade-off.
blocks.zh: 推论预算和部署硬件。 减少欧拉整合预算会降低耐久性,但单步采样会大幅降低部署路线上的LPIPS. 所报告的运行时间是在V-D节所述装有RTX A6000的机器人上测量的,因此不应将其解释为在较小的机载计算机上保证实时性能. 适应性解决器和加速流量取样是改善这种质量-成本权衡的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en: We presented M3GD, a robotic novel view synthesis approach that composes independently trained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation models through projection, without pretraining a cross-modal translator. The key observation is that, after camera projection, frozen point-cloud features share substantial spatial structure with frozen image-foundation latents. This makes a simple RGB–LiDAR packet viable: the generative backbone keeps its latent space, decoders, camera conditioning, and training objective, while each view receives spatially aligned 3D evidence on the grid it already uses for synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了M3GD,是一种机器人小说视图合成方法,它通过投影来编程独立训练的2D图像和3D点云基模型,而没有预先训练一个跨模式的翻译. 关键观察是,在摄像头投影后,冷冻点云特征与冷冻的图像建立潜伏物具有实质性的空间结构。 这使得简单的RGB–LiDAR包是可行的:基因主干保持其潜伏空间、解码器、相机配置和培训目标,而每个视图在它已经用于合成的网格上接收空间一致的立体证据。

blocks.en: On GrandTour, M3GD improves target-view RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version of the same backbone, with the largest gains on depth metrics. Ablations show that the benefit comes from real, pixel-aligned LiDAR content rather than adapter capacity, and that the target-view packet acts as a geometric query linking the requested view to the source observations without revealing target appearance. On a ground robot with a different sensor suite, the same GrandTour-trained model runs without retraining, and the number of Euler steps trades latency for perceptual quality. Together, these results suggest a practical pattern for robotic perception: once 2D and 3D foundation representations are projected into a shared view-local frame, a lightweight conditioning pathway can expose their complementary knowledge to a generative model without rebuilding the synthesizer around a new modality.
blocks.zh: 在GrandTour上,M3GD改进了目标-视图RGB和深度合成,比同一骨干只使用图像的版本,在深度度量标准上收获最大. 缩写显示,好处来自真实的,像素对齐的LiDAR内容而不是适配器容量,目标视图包起到将所请求的视图与源观测连接起来的几何查询的作用,而不透露目标外观. 在一个具有不同感官套件的地面机器人上,同一个GrandTour训练的模型在没有再培训的情况下运行,欧乐步数交易了潜伏度以达到感官质量. 这些结果表明机器人感知的实用模式:一旦2D和3D基础表现投射到一个共享的视野-局部框架,一个轻量级的调节路径可以将其互补知识暴露在基因模型上,而不会围绕一种新的模式重建合成器.
